citations.title: Airbus names ASML, Michelin CEOs to board as Obermann steps down

sentences.quote: Airbus names ASML, Michelin CEOs to board as Obermann steps down
sentences.text: Airbus has named ASML's chief executive, along with Michelin's CEO, to its board as Obermann steps down, pointing to an outside board role for ASML's top executive.
Separately, an ASML executive publicly stated that the company, described as Europe's biggest firm, has no sales in Europe.
